versions.changelog:
Initial release of Breakup Buddy — a tool for untangling shared lives at the end of cohabiting relationships.

- Catalog all shared physical items, purchase info, and assign splitting rules.
- Audit and manage shared digital accounts, subscriptions, and services with clear transfer/cancel flags.
- Track and reconcile shared expenses for a clean, single settle-up payment.
- Generate move-out checklists, including handoff logistics and legal-adjacent tasks.
- Centralized report and status command covers all shared assets, accounts, and pending actions.
- 100% local storage; keeps sensitive data private.
